decision: Do not construct customer longitudinal sequences from nameOrig.
reasons: 99.85% of origin identifiers occur only once.
The public identifiers do not link fraudulent transfer destinations to fraudulent cash-out origins.
isFlaggedFraud covers only 16 of 8213 fraud transactions and cannot serve as general detection time.
Post-transaction balance fields may reveal cancelled fraud outcomes and are excluded from leakage-safe designs.
